graduationRequirements.name: Civics and Patriotism
notes: Students who pass their required government course satisfy the one-semester state civics requirement. Must pass assessments on Patriotism and Principles of Representative Government.

graduationRequirements.name: Driver Education
waiverRules: Complete Driver Education at Stevenson, submit certificate from commercial school, or provide driver's license issued prior to age 18.
notes: Students must earn eight credits in previous two semesters to be eligible for Driver Education.

graduationRequirements.name: Elective Credits
notes: At least two elective semester credits must come from Applied Arts, Fine Arts, Multilingual Learning and/or Computer Science, Engineering and Technology.

graduationRequirements.name: Economics or Personal Finance
notes: Students must complete a semester of economics or personal finance.

graduationRequirements.name: English
notes: Eight credits required for graduation; two writing-intensive courses required.

graduationRequirements.name: Health
notes: One semester/credit of Health Education is required for graduation, including participation in a unit on Adult CPR.

graduationRequirements.name: Mathematics
notes: At least six semesters/credits required including algebra and one course with geometry content.

graduationRequirements.name: Physical Welfare / PE
waiverRules: Waivers: Dance, Health Education (first time), Applied Health, Driver Education (first time), athletic waiver, Marching Band or Color Guard, senior academic waiver.
notes: Students must participate in Physical Education each semester unless they meet waiver conditions.

graduationRequirements.name: Science
notes: Two semesters of biological science and two semesters of physical science required.

graduationRequirements.name: Social Studies
eligibleCourses: AP United States Government and Politics
notes: Two semesters/credits of U.S. History (or AP U.S. History); two semesters/credits of World History and Geography; one semester/credit of Government (or AP United States Government and Politics), including passing specific assessments on Patriotism and Principles of Representative Government in the required government course to satisfy the state requirement for graduation.

graduationRequirements.name: ACT
notes: The ACT is the state's high school accountability exam in Illinois. All students in public high schools are required to participate in the ACT Suite of Assessments. Stevenson High School adheres to the requirements of the Illinois State Board of Education (ISBE) and will administer the Digital PreACT 9 to all freshman students, Digital PreACT to all sophomore students and the Digital School-day ACT to all junior students. It is important to note that the school-day ACT given to juniors in the spring is a graduation requirement in the State of Illinois. No other ACT administration fulfills this requirement. ACT scores are not included on a student's transcript. For information on the Suite of Assessments and more detail on the timeline of these exams, visit Stevenson's website at www.d125.org.
